case: BRAF-associated compound prioritization in A375 melanoma cells
selection_basis: Established BRAF V600E A375 context and available known-target training support, selected before scoring. Initial saved-prediction coverage audit found only one evaluable candidate; expand the library before reading endpoint values.
dta_prediction: Mean of the five frozen identity-disjoint fold models; every candidate absent from all KIBA training/validation/test identities. Apply each fold prior, validation-selected blend and gate before averaging predictions.
chemical_identity: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES retaining salt, charge and tautomer state; no name-only joins
candidate_library: All CTRPv2 chemical identities exactly matched to QC-passing A375 LINCS chemical profiles at the fixed dose/time, excluding all KIBA chemical identities; retain every candidate within the existing 512-explicit-atom encoder capacity
quality: qc_pass == 1 for treated profiles; matched vehicle/vector controls retained independently of perturbation QC
functional_score: Pearson correlation across all 978 aligned landmark genes between compound-minus-vehicle and BRAF-CRISPR-loss-of-function-minus-vector mean profiles; positive concordance favored. Resolve matrix positions before filtering, average unique signatures within perturbagen then perturbagens within chemical identity.
combination: Unweighted mean of candidate-library percentile ranks for DTA affinity and functional concordance; no CTRP-based fitting
endpoint: CTRPv2 AUC_curvecurator, finite measured values; lower AUC means stronger cellular response; median across duplicate chemical-identity records

bootstrap.interval: paired percentile 95%; conditional on fixed predictions; ranking tie-break by canonical identity

interpretation: Retrospective measured-response-assisted prioritization with a separate cellular viability endpoint; not fully in-silico G2CP inference or independent biochemical affinity validation
boundaries: KIBA target sequence does not encode the A375 BRAF V600E cellular genotype
Binding affinity does not specify inhibition direction or cellular efficacy
Chemical and genetic perturbations have different experimental times
General cellular stress can produce concordance without direct BRAF engagement
CTRP data were previously used in a separate local DrEval exploratory project; this is not an untouched dataset across the entire workspace
No model or combination is fitted on the cellular endpoint
